verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's core payment lifecycle (payments, refunds, voids, payment links, webhooks, reconciliation, platforms/sub-entities, FX) is fully API-driven per docs, and the API is treated as the primary integration surface rather than the UI. However, some Dashboard-only or UI-centric functions (e.g., some fraud rule configuration, risk list management, business account setup, certain reporting views) are only shown via Dashboard screenshots/flows without confirmed API parity, and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable (404s on probes) to verify full API surface coverage. missing for 10: confirmed API parity for all Dashboard-configurable settings (risk rules, fraud lists, business account management), a public/complete OpenAPI spec, and independent evidence confirming no UI-only features exist.
